projects.title: Lycosa
projects.summary: A LAN-first distributed platform for orchestrating local and cloud AI agents.
projects.description: Lycosa turns workstations, laptops, homelab systems, and mini-PCs into a cooperative AI execution fabric. Its controller discovers devices, recommends roles from their hardware, schedules tasks with failover, routes RAG knowledge requests, coordinates approval-gated workflows, and streams live operations into a cross-platform desktop dashboard.

visualJourney.title: From node inventory to execution graph
visualJourney.description: Two complementary views of the distributed AI fabric: operational node details and the live controller topology.

images.alt: Lycosa desktop dashboard showing connected AI nodes in a list
images.caption: Live node inventory
images.description: Machine status, assigned roles, recommendations, heartbeat timing, CPU, and memory are visible in one operational list.

images.alt: Lycosa desktop dashboard graph showing distributed AI nodes connected to a controller
images.caption: Distributed execution graph
images.description: An interactive topology shows registered devices, controller relationships, node roles, and live resource metrics.

projects.title: SafeHear-AI
projects.summary: An urban emergency-sound detection system powered by machine learning.
projects.description: SafeHear-AI is a CNN-based audio classifier for emergency and normal urban sounds. It achieved 97.02% validation accuracy using acoustic features, enabling sound-based situational awareness without visual surveillance.

visualJourney.title: From urban audio intake to explainable threat assessment
visualJourney.description: A privacy-preserving workflow that processes audio in batches, benchmarks the trained model, and turns acoustic features into clear emergency or safety decisions.

images.alt: SafeHear-AI live inference interface with multiple urban WAV files ready for analysis
images.caption: Batch audio intake
images.description: Operators can drag and drop multiple WAV recordings, review the selected files, and confirm that the batch is ready for real-time AI analysis.

images.alt: SafeHear-AI research benchmark comparing historical audio classifiers with the current privacy-preserving model
images.caption: Research-backed model performance
images.description: The benchmark view compares established UrbanSound8K baselines with SafeHear-AI's robust CNN, highlighting its 97.02% validation accuracy and privacy-preserving emergency focus.

images.alt: SafeHear-AI detecting a gunshot with high confidence beside its Mel spectrogram
images.caption: High-confidence emergency detection
images.description: A gunshot sample is classified as an emergency with 99.96% confidence, paired with its Mel-spectrogram and an immediate recommendation to alert first responders.

images.alt: SafeHear-AI classifying ambient traffic audio as a secure environment beside its Mel spectrogram
images.caption: Normal urban sound verification
images.description: Ambient traffic audio is recognized as a safe routine environment with 99.67% confidence, demonstrating that the model distinguishes everyday city noise from genuine threats.

projects.title: Sahilha
projects.summary: An Arabic study companion for planning subjects, focused sessions, exams, and achievements.
projects.description: Sahilha is a student-focused Arabic web platform created for Umm Al-Qura University. Its RTL experience brings study planning into one calm workspace with a personalized dashboard, configurable Pomodoro sessions, subject notes, exam and quiz scheduling, progress statistics, motivational streaks, achievements, and direct links to essential university services.

visualJourney.title: From daily study planning to consistent academic progress
visualJourney.description: A focused Arabic RTL workflow that helps students understand their day, protect concentration time, organize every subject, and stay motivated through visible progress and achievements.

images.alt: Sahilha Arabic RTL student dashboard with study statistics, upcoming exams, daily advice, and university links
images.caption: Personalized study dashboard
images.description: A welcoming overview combines the student's study streak, total focused time, subjects, Pomodoro sessions, earned badges, upcoming exams, daily guidance, and quick university links.

images.alt: Sahilha configurable Arabic Pomodoro study timer with focus and break durations
images.caption: Configurable focus timer
images.description: Students can tailor study and break durations, choose a subject, and run structured Pomodoro sessions that turn focused work into measurable progress.

images.alt: Sahilha Arabic subject management interface with notes and exam scheduling
images.caption: Subjects, notes, and assessments
images.description: Each subject becomes an organized workspace for personal notes and dated exams or quizzes, while new courses can be added quickly from the same screen.

images.alt: Sahilha Arabic achievement gallery showing locked and completed study milestones
images.caption: Motivating achievement system
images.description: Progress-based badges reward useful habits such as adding subjects, completing focus sessions, recording assessments, maintaining a study streak, and reaching long-term study milestones.

projects.title: Public Library
projects.summary: A responsive web application for browsing books, discovering events, and contacting the library.
projects.description: Public Library is a lightweight full-stack web application designed for small libraries and educational institutions. It digitizes essential services through a responsive book catalog, interactive book information, upcoming event listings, user authentication, and a contact form backed by message storage, with practical error handling and basic security measures.

visualJourney.title: From library discovery to community participation
visualJourney.description: A clear, responsive experience that introduces the library, helps visitors explore its collection, reveals useful book context, and keeps the community informed about upcoming activities.

images.alt: Public Library home page with navigation, welcome message, and library imagery
images.caption: Welcoming library home page
images.description: The landing page establishes the library identity and gives visitors direct access to books, events, contact services, and account login through a simple navigation system.

images.alt: Public Library responsive catalog showing book covers, titles, and authors
images.caption: Visual book catalog
images.description: A responsive card grid makes the collection easy to scan by presenting recognizable covers alongside each book's title and author.

images.alt: Public Library book catalog displaying an interactive description for a selected title
images.caption: Contextual book descriptions
images.description: Interactive descriptions reveal a concise synopsis beside the selected book, helping readers understand a title without leaving the catalog.

images.alt: Public Library upcoming events page with event descriptions, dates, times, and locations
images.caption: Upcoming community events
images.description: Structured event cards bring together activity details, dates, times, and locations for reading sessions, writing workshops, and children's programs.
